notes.title: Seccond update for The Week With Grugles 2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone! The Week With Grugles just got another update![/b]

Mostly just to fix one bug:

Bug Fixes:

Removed the glitch that sometimes replaces Baxter's jump scare animation with a still PNG of an evil Bart Simpson that crashes the game (I have no clue why it's even there, probably a placeholder I forgot to remove)

New Features:

None, I really just wanted to get rid of Bart

[i]If there are any issues please submit them to the [url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.gle%2F2PgyGQnfUqfnvXQg8"]feedback forum[/url], (this forum is for all bugs and feedback by the way)[/i]
[b]
I hope you guys enjoy the game![/b][/p]

notes.title: First update for The Week With Grugles
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! I'm happy to announce that The Week With Grugles just got its first update since launch![/b] (yesterday)

Here's some of the stuff that got added:

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that did not let you skip the credits
[/list]

New Features:
[list]
[*] Made nights slightly longer, they were going by too fast, so I made them last a little longer.
[*] Made it so that the toggle for controllers is also a button that can be clicked in case a controller is not connected
[*] Added more languages!
[/list]

Languages:
Added 3 new languages
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Polish
[*] German
[/list]
[i]I'm going to be honest with you guys, I used Google Translate for most of the languages added, so the grammar might be a little poor. If there are any issues please submit them to the [url=https://forms.gle/2PgyGQnfUqfnvXQg8]feedback forum[/url], (this forum is for all bugs and feedback by the way)[/i]
[b]
I hope you guys enjoy the game![/b]
